build_multilingual_transformer_model: build a multilingual transformer model instance with shared encoder and decoder embeddings across language pairs
add_multilingual_transformer_args: add multilingual transformer CLI arguments like share-encoders and share-decoders to an argparse parser
load_multilingual_state_dict: load a state dictionary into the multilingual transformer model filtering keys by registered language pairs
configure_base_multilingual_architecture: configure the base multilingual transformer architecture with default shared embedding and encoder settings
configure_iwslt_de_en_architecture: configure the multilingual transformer IWSLT German-English architecture with 512-dim embeddings and 6 layers
